title: Shape a requirements-aware review with isolated checkers
narrative: Fangore is wiring a change review against applicable user stories. He loads the requirements-review template, confirms isolated reviewers and atomic checks are present in the expanded graph, and verifies the shape is ready for real gap cases. Related: `fangore_insp_independent_review`, `fangore_decision_plane_policy`.[^jev-us06]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `independent_review` provides isolated reviewer context. Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` runtime answers bounded coverage/gap questions. Host policy maps gaps and deterministic facts to `request_tests` or escalate; `mark_correct` is never emitted from judge confidence alone.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/template_shape.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
